title: fifa_data.csv carries almost no Brazilian-club players, so club filters for Brazilian clubs return empty
evidence: tests/test_main.c:337-338 comment and agent log 'flamengo players=0'; tool_player_search club filter works (PSG returns players) but Flamengo/Palmeiras clubs are absent from the FIFA source
suggestion: No code change needed — R8 is met via nationality filter and non-Brazilian club filter. Document the data limitation in README so users don't read empty results as a bug.

title: Top scorers query not implemented
evidence: src/tools.c:272-288 TOOLS[] exposes search_matches, team_record, standings, match_stats, player_search — no top-scorers tool; the match CSVs carry no goalscorer column so it is not inferable
suggestion: Optional spec item only (Competition Queries 'Top scorers if inferable from data'); not a required capability. No action needed.

title: Cross-source fixture dedupe may collapse distinct same-day same-score fixtures
evidence: src/dataset.c:142-148 same_fixture() treats matches with identical teams/competition/score within a ±1 day window as duplicates, keeping the lowest-numbered source
suggestion: Intentional to merge overlapping Brasileirao fixtures across the 2003-2019 and primary files; tests pass. Acceptable as designed.
